capabilities: detect internal links and embedded media in the active note
create a sibling folder named after the note
move linked files into the folder with collision-avoiding numbering
update all affected links vault-wide via the native API
run as a command that can be bound to a hotkey
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to collect a note's linked files and embeds into a dedicated folder without manually sorting files and fixing links.
summary: Command-based plugin that moves all notes and attachments linked in the active note into a new sibling folder named after that note.
